_comment: Bedrock Knowledge Base configuration for metadata-driven natural language search
_description: This KB indexes the metadata table summaries for natural language queries like 'Find all invoices from Q1 2025 with amount > $10,000'

knowledgeBase.name: fsxn-metadata-catalog-kb
knowledgeBase.description: Natural language search over FSx for ONTAP unstructured file metadata. Indexes AI-generated summaries, classifications, and file attributes.

dataSource._comment: Data source: Export metadata summaries as documents for KB ingestion
dataSource.name: metadata-summaries
dataSource.description: AI-generated summaries from the Iceberg metadata table, exported as text documents

setup_steps: 1. Create OpenSearch Serverless collection (vector search type)
2. Create IAM role with bedrock:* and aoss:* permissions
3. Export metadata summaries to S3 (use export-summaries.py)
4. Create Knowledge Base via AWS Console or API
query_examples: Find all engineering drawings related to pump design from 2025
Show me contracts with amounts over $100,000
What medical images do we have from the radiology department?
List all PDF reports classified as specifications
_usage_notes.integration_with_agents: Use Bedrock Agents to combine KB search with file access via FSx S3 AP. Agent can: (1) search metadata via KB, (2) retrieve file via S3 AP, (3) process with Bedrock Claude.
